title: healthdata: Download and read NHANES health survey data in Python
description:
healthdata is a Python package that finds, downloads and reads NHANES (National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey) data files from the CDC. It saves each file's codebook alongside the data, renames cryptic variable codes to readable column names, and attaches the documentation for every variable to the resulting pandas DataFrame.

Source code: https://github.com/nidhog/healthdata. Package: https://pypi.org/project/healthdata/.
